experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 200 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; li.d $r5, -1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'vfsqrt.d $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.d $r7, $vr0, 0; and $r7, $r7, $r5; or $r7, $r7, $r6; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r7'

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency. Chain: tested op, then vpickve2gr.d+and+or+vreplgr2vr.d to restore the input pattern; the 7-cycle closure is subtracted (calibrated with vadd.b/xvadd.b). Swept 26 operand values including 0, powers of two, max, minnorm, maxsub, minsub, Inf and NaN: latency 8-37 cycles, CPI 4.495-19. The stored experiment uses 1.0. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfsqrt.d $vr0, $vr8; vfsqrt.d $vr1, $vr9; vfsqrt.d $vr2, $vr10; vfsqrt.d $vr3, $vr11; vfsqrt.d $vr4, $vr12; vfsqrt.d $vr5, $vr13; vfsqrt.d $vr6, $vr14; vfsqrt.d $vr7, $vr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; vreplgr2vr.d $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfsqrt.d $vr0, $vr8; vfsqrt.d $vr1, $vr9; vfsqrt.d $vr2, $vr10; vfsqrt.d $vr3, $vr11; vfsqrt.d $vr4, $vr12; vfsqrt.d $vr5, $vr13; vfsqrt.d $vr6, $vr14; vfsqrt.d $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput, 8 independent lanes. CPI ranges 4.495-19 over the same 26-value sweep; the stored experiment uses 1.0.
